_meta.doc: The 133 GATE rows of the 2026-08-20 bracket-geometry sweep, extracted from the 19 per-leg reports under runtime_logs/e35_bracket/*/2026-08-20/report.json. Those reports are 37MB and runtime_logs/ is GITIGNORED, so they do not survive the container that produced them — this file is the durable evidence, and it is what a matrix-vs-artifact agreement guard can actually read in CI. The 3,781 SURFACE cells are deliberately NOT carried: the gate rows are what the matrix column was derived from, and a corpus nobody can diff against the matrix is not evidence.
